text: Centaur Firecallers are level 6 centaur pyromancers appearing in the Founding of Durotar campaign.

Cassa Crimsonwing is a dwarf found standing next to Baldruc, the gryphon master of Theramore Isle and her mentor. She is involved in the quest Survey Alcaz Island - speaking to her while on the quest will allow you to fly around the island to complete the quest. It's unknown if she survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.
Captain Fizzlesneer is goblin zeppelin captain of the Bilgewater Cartel located in the Twilight Highlands. He flies the horde from Dragonmaw Port to the Krazzworks.
Bridget Bran is a human flight master located at the Timbered Strand in Drustvar.
:Brimstone and fire follow in his wake. Bonechewer Behemoths are giant fel orcs found in the Halls of Anguish in the Black Temple.

__NOTOC__ Blubbergut is an orca that swims around the Sar'theris Strand near Shadowprey Village in Desolace. He's causing trouble for the trolls of the nearby village, and has become too big for their spears to handle.
Blackklaw was the ebon gryphon mount of Daerion of the Stormwind Assassin's Guild, who tried to kill Lo'Gosh. Blackklaw was killed by Valeera Sanguinar.

Belnistrasz is a red dragon quest giver found in Razorfen Downs. He appears as a human. Belnistrasz cares not for politics; he cares not if anyone's affiliations are for either Horde or Alliance. He is more interested in squelching direct and dire threats to all the races. And he has found one in Razorfen Downs. Since Warlords of Draenor, his whereabouts are unknown.

Some shaman, devote themselves to the warlike aspects inherent in their abilities. They still possess a modicum of magical ability, but train their bodies and reflexes to focus more on combat. In many ways, these battle shaman are the Horde's answer to paladins, and their enemies nervously finger their blades when they see one in the opposing ranks. By drawing on the anger of the spirits, an experienced battle shaman can strike their enemies dead instantly.
Baron Geddon is a fire elemental boss found in the Molten Core. He patrols near Shazzrah's spawn area while guarding the Rune of Zeth.

.]] Azmerloth is an alternate universe of Azeroth where everyone is a murloc. It is visited during the Temporal Conflux storyline of Thaldraszus, where adventurers are teleported to the Mrrglblight, local equivalent of the Dragonblight, during the local time of the Dragon Soul raid. Azmerloth has its own Alliance and Horde equivalents, respectively led by Varian Wryngrrlgulgll and Thrallgrulgulgul. They oppose Deathwingurlugull. Perhaps surprisingly, these murlocs have mastered flight, for gunships and gyrocopters can be seen during the battle, including the Finning Furies squadron. Later, time rifts tore into Azmerloth and brought Finduin Wryngrrlgulgll, High Tide-King of Azmerloth, into Az

Azgar is an ashen elemental located on a cliff in the Ember Ward in Revendreth. It controls a number of Ashen Cylcones, making travel in the area dangerous. During combat, Azgar will sometimes pop its Smoldering Ward ability, run away, then stop and cast Torrent of Ash.

Arnokk the Burner is Commander Vorka's pyromaniacal lieutenant and a member of the Iron Horde. He is first seen discussing supply shipments with Sadana Bloodfury in Shaz'gul, flanked by a pair Warsong Ragemongers, and later participates in the Iron Horde's attack on Karabor, incinerating everything in his path.

__NOTOC__ Archduke Calcinder is a flamewaker in the Slag Pit of the Searing Gorge who controls the Dark Iron dwarves in the area. He must be banished using the Consecrated Tripetricine in a Thorium Brotherhood quest.

:For how to defeat his Undead Form found in Karazhan see Nightbane (tactics) and Nightbane (Return to Karazhan tactics). Arcanagos was a powerful blue dragon who traveled to Karazhan just prior to the First War to confront Medivh, who unbeknownst to Arcanagos was possessed by Sargeras, lord of the Burning Legion.

Apata Highmountain is a Highmountain tauren huntress who accompanies the hunter player in search of the legendary tauren spear, Talonclaw, along with her brother Wuho. She is first encountered upstairs in the Arsenal Absolute in Dalaran, where she briefly tells the player about Talonclaw's history and its current whereabouts. If the player chooses to pursue Talonclaw as their first artifact, Apata and the player fly together to Spiritwatch Point in Highmountain in order to consult the Eagle Spirit, Ohn'ahra, but once they arrive it becomes apparent that the Point is under attack from strange plant creatures. Apata is pulled down while the player lands farther north, after which the adventure

.]] Ancient protectors are green, leafy ancients with a beard of thick leaves and moss. The early purpose of these primeval guardians was to defend the resting places of the druids as they slept. Called into service for the Third War, these wardens dedicate their existence to the defense of their brethren and the forested lands of Ashenvale. These mighty ancients can also hurl enormous boulders at any enemies who threaten the tranquility of the night elves' villages. Valuable ancient, critical in the security of night elf civic areas and groves. The owl-faced ancients hurl massive boulders at all interlopers who dare desecrate the sacred groves of the night elves. They are also the quickest
Amelia Clarke is a dragon disguised as a human vendor located at the Stormshield in Ashran.
Alter Time is a mage class talent. It allows the caster to set a point in time and then return to it once, resetting their health and location to the set point.
Alruathis is a green dragon located in the Victorious Visage in Valdrakken. He can be found talking to a Salon Patron.
Alluvius is an ice elemental located at the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra. He is summoned to help you against Lord Kryxix.
Algeth'ar Acolytes are dragons in elf visages located in Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.

Aleifir is a storm drake located at Thorim's Peak in Stormheim. When the Felskorn attacked the Thorignir, Aleifir was one of the drakes that defended the brood and caught captured in the process. He was later freed by adventurers.

Akil'darah is an eagle loa and the eagle spirit of the Hinterlands. Her totem can be found in Jintha'Alor and was initially controlled by the Vilebranch trolls. After Horde adventurers decimated the Vilebranch's ranks, the totem was freed and Akil'darah joined the side of the Revantusk tribe, allowing Kotonga to transport adventurers to the eagle spirit's totem "on the winds of her blessing".

An Eternal of Sothis (originally known as Djet Sopdet) is a Follower of Set who has lived through an entire Sothic Turn, meaning exactly 1460 solar years. This is the age a vampire is considered a Methuselah. The Tenth Hour of the Journey by Night is exclusively staffed by Eternals of Sothis. Eternals are revered as demigods by the Clan, whose words have the authority of the Lord of Storms himself. An Eternal is counted as a direct childer of Set, regardless of his actual lineage, although the Setites explain that this is more of a metaphor to explain their exalted state. Among the Eternals are the Hierophants, the most ancient of Setites and the true stewards of the Clan in their god's abse

El Cuchillo is renowned in Southern California and Mexico for his superspeed and agility... and not much else. He has limited imagination and has media agencies set up "masked duels". He claims to have never lost a duel. Otherwise he will have to forfeit his mask. El Cuchillo is an egotistical lout, and it is only a matter of time before some nova knocks some sense into him.
Prideful Dian Cécht, also known as Cainte and Canta, grandfather of Lugh, is the pantheon's most prominent healer, a God of medicine.

The Cabiri (singular Cabirus) are a Dynasty of Egyptian Mummies that originated not in Egypt but in Greece. They're Immortals but have little to no connection to the struggle between Apophis and the Ma'at. As of the Sixth Great Maelstrom and the creation of the Amenti with Osiris' new Spell of Life, they're on the brink of extinction.
Bolade Atwan is the Proxy of teleportation and the founder of the Upeo wa Macho
Benoit "Zip" Goubeaux is a nova who has been captured by a cult and is being eaten alive bit by bit! The only thing keeping "Zip" alive is his ability to Regenerate.
Balam-Colop are a race of shapeshifting humanoid jaguars found in the Blasphemies book.

Arbina, the Sheltering Maple is a Plant Kami Host which can take on human form and has sap that possesses healing properties. She exacts vengeance on those who deliberately despoil the wilderness and is helpful to Garou who ask her politely for assistance.

Araska is a daeva who was active during the last days of Alexander the Great's reign. Summoned by the Moros Alkaios, the daeva immediately began plotting to acquire its freedom. Araska is immortal, and though it can be weakened and temporarily banished, it cannot be killed. Binding it is the closest thing to a permanent solution there is. Though thought to be a demonic being serving , mechanically, Araska is a relatively powerful spirit with a numen that enables it to steal a victim's soul.
Araen the Ancient Flame with Wings is a Pack Totem to the Howl to Mock the Dead Pack in Colorado.
Unicorn is pure, powerful, strong, and wise. She is a totem spirit of peace, harmony, and healing, and is the Patron Spirit of the Children of Gaia.
Ambrose Gant is a powerful psychic trapped in a coma at Bishopsgate Mental Asylum.
The Swara, also called the Silver Folk, are the werecheetahs of the Bastet tribes. Like their kin, they are extremely fast and travel much. They also have a unique link with the Umbra.

Shadowland Passage is a Thaumaturgical ritual that allows a vampire to physically pass into any location in the Shadowlands provided that they have been in that location before. The vampire symbolically "kills" themself by plunging a specially prepared dagger into their heart (doing at least 2 lethal wounds) and falling into a body of water deep enough to cover them. The dagger must be made from the purest silver and the hilt must have a least one vampire fang worked into its construction. When they return from the Shadowlands, they will reappear in the water.
The Shih are the traditional demon hunters of the Middle Kingdom, using their own Chi in applications known as Qiao to achieve superhuman powers.
Runnerswift is one of the sub-types of the Beast seeming - beasts of great speed. Their blessing is Runs Like the Wind.
The Sakhmu are one of the six Dynasties of the Amenti, the Egyptian immortals most commonly known as mummies.

Rebecca Bue Li, born in the Philippines, was one of several people chosen by the Doyen to become a proxy for a psi order. Bue Li was selected as the proxy of telepathy, and founded the Ministry of Noetic Affairs.

The Renders are the Pandoran Mockery of the Ulgan Lineage of Prometheans. Renders are alien creatures who provoke the Disquiet with ease: their unnatural speed, misplaced joints, and filmy eyes all seem somehow wrong. They seek to tear apart the bodies of Prometheans, who they instinctively believe were never meant to be whole, with horrifically sharp talons. Prometheans captured by Renders are usually subject to intense torture, as the creatures tear off limbs and other troublesome body parts; they then rend the flesh of their victims as they feed. The feeding is usually slow and excruciating for the Promethean, and nothing recognizable is usually left when they are done. Renders look like

Rakan Thulio, also known as the Sleepwalker, is a rogue Sidereal, a Chosen of Endings who has set himself against Yu-Shan, seeking to tear it down, and towards that end, he has allied with a hitherto unseen group of Exalted, the Getimians. He Exalted in the Time Before, but after tearing his thread from the Loom of Fate, he has not aged a day since, making him one of, if not the, oldest Exalted currently active.

Ahzra the Unliving, was a vampire of clan Tzimisce during the time of the First Crusade. She had long red hair and was heavily modified by Vicissitude, with large fangs and bony ridges on her forehead. She also wore a cloak made out of living flesh, which moved on its own.

Adonijah, also known as Re or Gideon, is a true immortal Sage of Jerusalem. He lived in the city since its founding and lived over 2200 years by the time of the Dark Ages. An ancient Hebrew, he met the ancient King David and King Solomon and befriended the Malkavian Antediluvian before he fell into torpor beneath the city. Adonijah protected the torpid body of Malkav in Jerusalem's deep, as well as the city, from darkness.

Patli was a Mesoamerican living within the Aztec Empire. Stolen away from his home and family by the angel Captor and experimented on within Facility 995, Patli was agonizingly changed into a monster with hands ending in mosquito probosces, skin made of armadillo hide, and the wings of dozens of swarms of insects. After Captor set him loose from the facility, he wandered the jungle, doing his best to avoid contact with humans, as he believed that returning to his family would only wind up destroying them.

The Abominable Snowman or Yetis, are a bygone creature that usually appears in the Himalayas. It appears to be a tall, furred humanoid of great strength. Most seem peaceful, but they can be quite ferocious when provoked or angered. Sages within the Akashic Brotherhood believe that one or two still survive on Earth.
Ogres are one of the changeling seemings. They are the strong and often brutal goblins and giants of Faerie, broad-backed and bloody-handed.

Nian Shun (not his original name) is an immortal who lives in who for centuries has sought a way to relieve the nature of Suffering and to reach perfect balance of the . He is one of the Reborn, one of the rarest supernatural entities known in popular myth as "mummies".

Mungu Kuwasha is mentioned in Aberrant as being a computer genius hired by ViaSoft in the early 21st century. By the time of the Aberrant War, Mungu Kuwasha, a.k.a. "Backlash", was the Aberrant responsible for the "electro-optical pulse" that destroyed the OpNet in 2061, setting communications technology back 100 years. This "pulse" was actually Kuwasha's death scream after an Opnet system wide battle between Alex "Synapse" Doan and Taint-maddened Mungu Kuwasha.

Mira Giovanni was a member of the extensive Giovanni family, and used to take a lot of drugs. She once shared a hit with someone she thought was clean. They weren't. She tested positive in late October 2004. With that news, she became dedicated to joining the inner circle of her family. While she may not have known any details, she was aware that the inner circle never aged. A senator from Massachusetts once told her that Uncle Bruno helped him with his first campaign... in 1950. She was willing to stop at nothing to get the opportunity to get the Proxy Kiss, and was seeking dirt on her competition, Adam Dunsirn and cousin Chris.

Melissanda Estevez is the current teleporter for Team Tomorrow. She is stationed with Team Tomorrow Americas, replacing Jennifer "Slider" Landers. Melissanda has a personal grudge against the Medellín Cartels.

Marianna, often called Marianna of Balador or the Queen of Pleasure, is the representative of the Cult of Ecstasy to the Council of Nine Mystic Traditions. She is a master of five of the Spheres (Correspondence, Life, Matter, Mind, and Time) and oversees the Horizon Realm of Balador in addition to her duties to the Council.
Maimonides (also known as Rabbi Moshe Ben Maimon, often shortened to Rambam) was a powerful Jewish kabbalist mage that achieved what many would deem impossible – reversing the curse of Caine.

Counterparts to the tribal Incarnae of the Firstborn, the Maeltinet are the primary servants and avatars of the Maeljin. They are dangerous spirits, as twisted as they are powerful, who dwell in the Shadow but also manifest in the physical realm to wreak havoc near Wounds.

The Lizard Kings, also called Dragon Kings or Dinosaur Kings, and often simply referred to as "dragons", were the greatest of the reptiles, according to Mokolé lore. They ruled over a period known as the Age of Kings, when dinosaurs walked the earth, but vanished during the Age of Sleep, after the Wonder-Work.

A Liche, also known in India as a Yamasattva, is born from a hermetic derivation of the Spell of Life that was contained in the writings of Cabirus, the founder of the Cabiri, and the studies of an Etruscan death mage. Because the spell is in itself relatively easy to cast compared to other methods to achieve immortality, it was alluring for members of the Order of Hermes since the days of Rome. The only problem is that the formula itself is forgotten, fragmented, censored and highly forbidden. The task of achieving lichedom can cost an entire lifetime. The Idran from India found a similar way to achieve a state of necrosynthesis before their destruction, turning into the vampiric Nagaraja.
An example of a destroyer Earthbound Thrall from the Demon: The Fallen core book. Kelly Finnegan has used his powers to burn down a empty hotel.
Irene is a strong eighth-generation Gangrel and a nomadic Feral of the Medieval period. She saved a young Liolya from nomadic vampires in the steppes of Kievan Rus, and eventually Embraced her.

Gereon Ignatius was a rogue Tremere elder and a member of the coterie of elders known as the Southern Lords in Georgia and other parts of the South. He met his end in the American Civil War, during Union General William Tecumseh Sherman's scourging of the city. Ignatius was too powerful and too stubborn to die however and now acts as a wraithly servant of the Council of Seven.

Hrolf Shipsplitter was an Uratha of Viking times renowned for his use of a fetish known as a Shieldbiter, a hatchet capable of easily breaking through wood. It was this fetish that earned him his name.

Gotzon was a powerful Lasombra of the Road of Heaven during the Dark Ages. A former Abyss Mystic, who performed the ritual Cry That Slays Light in 1230, he vowed to never use his power over shadows and living darkness again. An eerie figure favored by the Lasombra Antediluvian, Gotzon's abilities were more than enough to send shivers down the spine of many luminaries of his time – such as his longtime rival and friend Hardestadt.

:Cop-Bot is a Playskool Go-Bot in the Go-Bots continuity. A highly trained police agent, Cop-Bot specializes in law enforcement and peacekeeping. He uses his speedy vehicle forms to go from planet to planet, helping Go-Bots teams throughout the galaxy.

:Boomer is a Nebulan in the Generation One continuity family Boomer, a "double" Targetmaster is partnered with Ricochet and the Autobot Quickmix. His friends tell him "Ignorance is bliss." He doesn't get it, and even if he did Boomer isn't one to take offense, because that's just the kinda guy he is. As the head of the Consumer Complaint Agency on Nebulos he dealt with thousands of angry citizens all day. Boomer's trademark brand of loud, infectious good-hearted enthusiasm was his only marketable skill. Boomer thought that in comparison fighting Decepticons should be easy, so he joined the Autobots. Boomer was bio-engineered to turn into a sonic pulse cannon, which generates sound-waves or d

Optimus Prime is in Antarctica on the hunt for the second Iacon relic, the Apex Armor, a full-body suit of indestructible armor that expands from a small disc. However, he comes into conflict with both Dreadwing and Starscream during his search, and he is forced to form an uneasy alliance with Dreadwing when Starscream dons the Armor and threatens them both.

:Storm Surge is a Decepticon from the Movie continuity family. Storm Surge is a bad guy, apparently hiding out in Sector Seven's naval vehicle pool. He is well known for his tendency to attack literally everything in a fight. Corrosive salt blasts, napalm, depth charges...no Autobot avoids getting hit by these in a fight with him. Neither do his fellow Decepticons. This is in large part because Storm Surge doesn't believe in aiming. He believes that if he discharges a lot of ammo over a lot of ground, he's more likely—not guaranteed, just more likely—to hurt the opposition.
:Strong-Bot is a character in the Go-Bots continuity. Strong-Bot is the biggest, toughest, strongest Go-Bot there is. He is persistent and determined and will not stop until the job is done.

Eager to prove himself and make his name known in the Cybertronian music scene, Smooth Jazz (aka Autobot Jazz) is one of the newest members of the Knights of Unicron along with his friends/musical instruments Laserbeak and Ratbat. Smooth Jazz is known for his smooth grooves but has no qualms about cranking his music up to eleven and melting the faces off of concert-goers! {| class="fandom-table" |

:Sights is an Autobot Targetmaster from the Generation One continuity family. Sights is constantly on the lookout for anything that might enable his partner, Jackpot, to turn a seemingly-impossible feat into reality... and rack up the credits on the bets Jackpot placed on himself. When luck isn't enough, Sights can transform into a "Photon Cannon" that can connect to and exponentially amplify the power of Jackpot's own Photon Rifle. French-Canadian name: Vision Italian name: Falcon

Silencer is a Nebulan "double" Targetmaster partnered with Flintlock and the Autobot Landfill Silencer is a recovering pacifist. Once he lived the quiet traditional life of a non-ninja hydroponic farmer, disavowing violence for any reason. When Decepticons led by Scorponok destroyed his family's farm, his entire world and that way of life destroyed along with it. He is now one of the Autobots best warriors. Silencer turns into a noiseless, recoilless proton rifle. As a "double" Targetmaster, Silencer is able to combine with Flintlock to increase the power of his own weapon, or boost the power of Flintlock's stress pistol. It's unclear if Silencer's shoulder-mounted systems are defensive weap

Seekers are Fliers who are loyal to the Decepticons rather than the Autobots. They provided the Decepticons with invaluable air power against the Autobots during the Great War. Their Autobot counterparts are the Aerialbots. In Cyberverse, according to Shockwave, Seekers have extremely low intelligence.

:Scorpulator is a Decepticon from the Generation One continuity family. Scorpulator matches his partner Devastator perfectly. Both are near-mindless engines of destruction who wade into the thick of battle, attacking without reason or any strategy more complicated than "destroy everything". Be it with claws, lasers or acid, Scorpulator lives to fight.
Noctorro relies on his own body during combat instead of weapons. His short temper coupled with great strength make him a very dangerous opponent. :Italian name: Toro Alato

Shellshock's carefully honed Machina Minigun delivers a sustained burst of plasma fire. When he spots a likely target, he can also activate its Bullet Burn S-tech, which locks him in place and unleashes several volleys of plasma on the Autobot he's selected. When the gun overheats, he probably just switches to his other minigun. * Range: 5/8 * Shield Damage: 4/8 * Spark Damage: 2/8 Tip: Stationary or unsuspecting targets are particularly susceptible to Bullet Burn's attack.

:Lionbreast is a Decepticon in the Generation One continuity family. Lionbreast is the Breastforce partner of the team's leader, Leozack. Savage and cruel, it will happily obey his every command. Lionbreast can transform into both a mechnical lion and a handheld blaster.

:Holepunch is a Nebulan "double" Targetmaster partnered with Tracer and the Autobot Scoop in the Generation One continuity family. Holepunch is a bureaucrat from hell. He compensates for his complete lack of people skills or formal managerial training with the natural gifts of a bossy attitude and inflated sense of his own importance. As an office manager for a water purification company on Nebulos, Holepunch had only his subordinates to terrorize. When the Decepticons invaded, Holepunch (doubtless encouraged by his co-workers) concluded the Autobots were in need of his special touch. Holepunch turns into a dual compression cannon capable of shattering steel. As a "double" Targetmaster, Hole

Perhaps unsurprisingly, Gravity (グラビティ Gurabiti) wields the ability to manipulate gravitational forces, though only for a fixed period of time. This power can somehow be used to create "Gravity Armor" and weapons that increases the fighting ability of his partner Optimus Prime by 300%.

Gutcruncher is a very ambitious mechanoid. He's bartered a deal to sell Autobot remains as scrap metal on various interstellar markets (including to the Junkions!), and there are rumors that some of those parts were from fellow Decepticons who stood in Gutcruncher's way up the ranks. He's incredibly cold and calculating, and even without his Stratotronic Jet vehicle, he's got the muscle and firepower to back up his plans. Autobots fear him because he's a ruthless force of nature on the battlefield. Decepticons fear him because he may have already calculated their net worth to some shady black-market metal-monger, and is merely awaiting the right opportunity to cash in. :French name (Canada):
:Fast-Bot is a Playskool Go-Bot in the Go-Bots continuity. Fast-Bot is a powerful high-speed racer.
Xcthol is a sadistic, mind-controlling faun-like entity who was theorized to be related to Shub-Niggurath.

Voltiyig is an entity described as a feathered winged serpent with flaming nostrils, similarly to the Aztec god Quetzalcoatl and is imprisoned within a dark tower topped with a giant five-pointed star. He is a spawn of Yig.

Night-gaunts are a species of flying creatures in the Cthulhu Mythos, who first appeared in H. P. Lovecraft's novella The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath. They inhabit Earth's Dreamlands and are described as having smooth whale-like skin, long slender humanoid bodies, curving horns, leather bat-like wings, and a blank expanse of flesh where one would expect a face to be. They revere and worship Nodens as their lord and master. (: The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath) However, not all night-gaunts serve him; some serve Yibb-Tstll. (: Hero of Dreams [Brian Lumley], "The Descent into the Abyss") Yegg-Ha is probably the master of the night-gaunts who serve Yibb-Tstll. (: "The Descent into the Abyss")

In Middle-earth Role Playing and the Collectible Card Game, Itangast was a Fire-drake in the Grey Mountains. He is described as the deadliest and smartest of his kin in the Grey Mountains. As such only Scatha and Smaug are noted as his peers. He had blue-tipped black scales and long silvery horns. His lair was situated at Gold Hill, which was a knoll full of valuable ores. It was also a strategic site overlooking the Cirith Auris, a pass used to travel between Rhovanion and the Northern Waste. The only known treasure in his hoard is Sulthol (Q. “Wind Helm”), a helmet made by Edain who lived northwest of Dale in the Second Age.

Chrysophylax Dives was the name of the dragon who decided to invade the Middle Kingdom where Farmer Giles of Ham lived. Of ancient and imperial lineage, Chrysophylax was rich, cunning, inquisitive, greedy, well-armoured, but not overly bold. He lived in the mountains in a lair with brazen doors set upon great pillars.
Bears were large and ferocious animals of Middle-earth and Númenor. The Beornings were skin-changers who could appear in the form of either Men or bears.

The Wizards, commonly known as the Istari (Quenya) and the Ithryn (Sindarin) was the title assigned to five Maiar in the Third Age of Middle-earth. They formed the Order of Wizards (Q. Heren Istarion) . Among Men it was initially assumed that the Wizards were also men who, by long and secret study, had acquired great knowledge of lore and arts. However, as the Third Age passed it was marked that the Wizards did not die, so Men began to believe that they were of Elven-kind. However, none except Elrond, Círdan, and Galadriel knew that, in actuality, the Wizards were vassals of the Valar who were sent to assist the Free peoples of Middle-earth against Sauron as he gathered his forces during the

The Stargazer is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy found at the Stardust Pillar during the Lunar Events. It walks slowly, and will sometimes fire a thin Stardust Laser at the player. The Stargazer may move while firing the laser, but it cannot change the angle, similarly to the Charged Blaster Cannon on when firing its full beam.

The Spiderbot is a large spider-like Non-Humanoid Hunter Killer unit standing at a height of over three meters. It uses its long legs to traverse terrain and navigate obstacles a tracked vehicle would have problems negotiating. It possesses an underslung plasma cannon but at close range can use the tusk-like protrusions under its ocular array to gore human targets.

The T-800 Terminator is powered by a nuclear power cell (or nuclear-energy cell), located in the same approximate position as a human's heart, and is shielded in a case-hardened subassembly inside the triple-armored hyperalloy torso.

The Hunter-Killer Aerial Weapons Platform, also known as Hunter-Killer Aerial Weapons System,, or simply "CRS Labs Hunter-Killer", is a prototype automated by Cyber Research Systems to be an unmanned aerial weapons system as the organization was attempting to market to various military powers prior to 2004. It is the first generation of Skynet flying attack craft. During the Future War, the drone was upgraded into a Flyer Killer, armed with dual lasers instead of conventional machineguns. In addition, a bigger version of the prototype was later developed and deployed in the Future War.
Dino Breath or Fire Breath is an attack used by guest character Gon in the PlayStation version of Tekken 3.

Stone Zealots are powerful stone statues of zealots used by the Tal'darim to defend an alien artifact on Monlyth. The stone zealots have eyebeam weapons which resemble those of the colossus, though stone zealots can also attack air units. Despite having height similar to that of the colossus, stone zealots cannot be targeted by anti-air attacks. They look like normal zealot statues before being activated.

Skyrlings are a zerg breed created after the End War by Abathur as a smaller offshoot of the mutalisk. They were designed as part of Overqueen Zagara's efforts to create the adostra, capable of regrowing destroyed worlds, and were designed to carry the adostra from place to place. Skyrlings possess a form similar to mutalisks, but are much smaller, with a larger grasping claws and wider wings. They were designed to transport the adostra when they are fully grown. During the One-Day War, skyrlings were used to clear out the smoke from the last adostra nest, granting the terran and protoss team defending the nest the clean air they needed to care for their wounded.

Sloan was a ghost of the Terran Dominion before being recruited by Project Shadowblade. His identity was restored and thanks to terrazine exposure, his psionic powers intensified. During the Spectre Rebellion, he took part in a mission to Korhal Palace under the command of fellow spectre Gabriel Tosh. The mission was to assassinate Arcturus Mengsk. During the operation Sloan began to feel the effects of terrazine feedback, and was subdued by Tosh. Sloan later engaged in battle with the Terran Dominion ghosts defending Mengsk, killing the group and capturing two. However, Agent Nova Terra warded away the spectres from their assassination mission. Sloan survived the operation.

Spectres are terran special forces operatives with psionic powers granted by the psionic reagent terrazine. Many are or were elite ghost agents which have been exposed to terrazine. However, some were neurally resocialized troops who were subjected to the procedure, and would have lesser psionic power. Spectres were created as part of Project Shadowblade.

Rishagar is a female Khalai protoss. She is smaller than most protoss, and very slender. Rishagar was among the Khalai who settled on Shakuras. She helped Korlendir and Vartanil overcome their addictions to Sundrop through communing with them in the Khala. There she verified that their stories of surviving Aiur and of one of the last preservers, Zamara, being within the mind of a human named Jake Ramsey, were true.

Psionic shift is an psionic power demonstrated by Sarah Kerrigan during the Second Great War after she was reborn as a primal zerg. Using this ability, Kerrigan psionically dashes through enemies, doing damage to all she collides with.

N'rithaa (or "little arrow" in Khalani) is an interceptor aboard the carrier Koramund. It was under the care of Third Engineer Iaalu. During the Second Great War, Koramund was caught in a trap on the planet Vanass and crashed into the surface. Seeking out a pulse of life he felt from the ship, Iaalu explored the insides of the crashed carrier only to find all interceptors, including N'rithaa, still docked in pristine condition. When there hydralisks entered the room and began attacking him, Iaalu activated the independent fire-control circuits on N'rithaa, allowing it to shell the hydralisks with a hail of plasma fire.

Lekila was a high templar teacher, remaining at the Velari Templar School for 400 years and becoming very powerful in the Khala. In addition to her high templar abilities, she fought with a spear-like instrument.
The hybrid reaver is an extremely powerful zerg-based type of hybrid. They are capable of basic speech, and can exert control over zerg and terrans through mind control.

"Goliath Five" was a Terran Dominion Goliath pilot that served under Colonel Abram Cruikshank during the One-Day War. As Cruikshank saw Goliath pilots as quick to die and be replaced, he referred to these pilots as their squadron names. During the defense of the third adostra, Cruikshank's group, consisting of five Goliaths, two platoons of marines, a squad of reapers and Cruikshank's Warhound, were assigned to support a Daelaam force under Commander Alikka. Goliath Five, Goliath Three, and Goliath Four were assigned to support the line from the nearby mountains. However, during the battle one of Goliath Five's legs was damaged, causing it to aim improperly. Cruikshank ordered Goliath Five's

Glistrup is a Terran Dominion ghost. He posses the power of telekinesis, but is a manic depressive and compulsive liar. He served in the Ghost Program at the same time as Tanya Caulfield and , and he was deemed unsuitable by Ulavu for aid in his research due to his unstable nature.

]] E-gorbs are balls of electrical energy fired by Gary, an ability Egon Stetmann did not know Gary had. It travels in a line, dealing damage to all those caught in its path. When in an egonergy field, Gary can fire three E-Gorbs at a time.

Energy blast is a psionic power demonstrated by Sarah Kerrigan. The caster sends a burst of psionic energy at a target that deals high damage. The rate that this ability is case can be augmented by the Fury psionic power. Unlike psionic bolts, energy blasts launch as a stream of energy and not a single projectile. In Heart of the Swarm and Co-op Missions, energy blast serves as Kerrigan's basic attack.

The Dark Templar Hero was a powerful Dark Templar who assisted in the war between the settlers of Shakuras and Ulrezaj. Ulrezaj had stolen a sacred khaydarin crystal from Shakuras, and while tracking it, the protoss discovered that Ulrezaj had created five twisted khaydarin crystals on Char. He was using them to control zerg minions. Zeratul needed a dark archon to destroy the warped crystals, as only its psychic fury was capable of it. The Dark Archon Hero was accompanied by the Dark Templar Hero and other heroes.

Crushing grip is a psionic power demonstrated by Sarah Kerrigan during the Second Great War. Using the ability, Kerrigan was able to incapacitate a group of targets, holding them in mid-air while doing moderate damage. She was able to control the strength and intensity of this ability, and was able to use it on Valerian Mengsk only to lift him up by the neck and choke him, but not to deal lasting harm to him.
Confusion is a psionic power demonstrated by dark archons during the End War. The dark archon channels chaotic Void energies to drive its enemies to madness, causing them to turn against one another.

Consumption is a psionic power possessed by Gabriel Tosh. It converts 'life energy/force' into psionic energy that he can use, the amount of power being obtained being relative to the amount of 'life' available.

Housenka (ホウセンカ, Housenka) is a monster from the Dark Kingdom, and one of the Plant Sisters who works for Zoisite. She can shoot several small spheres similar to seeds simultaneously, which are highly explosive.

Campanula (カンパニュラ, Kanpanyura) is the flying Flower Youma that Sailor Moon and the other Sailor Guardians confront when they fly above the surface of Fiore's asteroid in Pretty Soldier Sailor Moon R: The Movie.

Choukokka is a Daimon that was sent by Eudial to help her extract Masanori Tsuzuki's Pure Heart Crystal. She was created from a pack of chisels by Professor Souichi Tomoe, and attacks by throwing chisels, trapping her enemies in a gravity barrier, and creating monsters out of sand.
Nipas is a droid sent by Berthier to take over a Crystal Point in Tokyo. She uses ice-based attacks and can freeze people with her breath.
Tsukune uses the power of his yoki to attack the opponent. Tsukune does not use this as often as punching an opponent but when used he attacks with other kicks as well.

Adam Scherr (September 6, 1983) is an American professional wrestler and strongman previously signed to World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) on the SmackDown brand under the ring name Braun Strowman. Strowman was a member of the Wyatt Family from 2015-2016, before later becoming a singles competitor. He is a one-time WWE Universal Champion, a two-time WWE Raw Tag Team Champion, one-time WWE Intercontinental Champion, the winner of the 2018 Greatest Royal Rumble, winner of the 2018 Men's Money in the Bank match and winner of the 2019 André the Giant Memorial Battle Royal.
Vinnie Dupree was a member of Quinn's team during a hostage retrieval mission in Mexico. They unexpectedly meet the Fugitive Predator. He kills him with a Plasmacaster.

Xenoborgs were cybernetically-enhanced cyborgs, created by the Weyland-Yutani Corporation in an attempt to make the ultimate "super-soldier" weapon at the end of the 22nd century. They were initially developed aboard the space station above Acheron (LV-426) in 2189.

The Snatcher was a variant of bred aboard the Weyland-Yutani Corporation research station known as the the Cold Forge. Bred from a chimpanzee, the variant received its name for its method of 'snatching' hosts using its unparalleled speed.

Chameleons are huge, unintelligent, reptilian creatures which live along with the Buhlagh on LV-1201. Because of their long arms and short legs, Chameleons walk in a gorilla-like fashion. When they are undisturbed, they distort into a ball-like form, resembling some kind of rock or plant. During this form, their skin turns to a brownish yellow. Another notable trait is their ability to ionize the oxygen in the air to create a concentrated beam, which is then expelled from their mouth. This beam is concussive and is mainly used to repel attackers.
The Jockey-Xenomorph was a born from an Engineer. The Jockey-Xenomorph was usually massive in size, far larger than any typical human-spawned Xenomorph.

Isabella Borgia was an industrialist and the founder and former CEO of Borgia Industries. Together with her son Hunter, she was credited with the reconstruction of Neonopolis after the almost complete destruction of the original city, New Way City, by the known as Scarface. Isabella's lifespan was unnaturally prolonged when she was exposed to Scarface's Yautja blood. She later formed the biological core of the first MOTHER supercomputer that governed the day-to-day operation of Neonopolis. She was finally killed when Scarface returned to Neonopolis in 2030, destroying her body at the center of MOTHER's core.
Hornhead, also known as Champion was the strongest warrior of the Tartarus Clan located on the planet LV-797. He was killed by Ahab in a duel on LV-223 to earn Ahab's right to re-join the tribe.

The Fire-Eater Alien is a Xenomorph born from the body of the super-heroine Fahrenheit. Fahrenheit's super power allowed her to throw fire, thus the Alien inherited this power and can spit fire by the mouth instead of acid.
Bat Aliens were s born from chiropteran or similar hosts. Due to the DNA reflex, their arms became large membranous wings, granting them the ability to achieve powered flight.

() is a /-type Pokémon introduced in Generation IV. It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards. They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
Flame of Truth was a unique Hellion who was the boss of the . He dealt fire damage and ignited the ground when he died.

Draconarius Wilhelm Flamebrand is a unique Blackguard Soldier, located on the highest floor of The Upper Sceptre of God. He is one of Dominus' champions. He uses Leap Slam that adds burning ground and a Fire form of Lightning Strike.

Trinian, Intellectus Prime is a unique Undying Archivist located in The Archives. They can summon multiple Book Tornadoes, a spell in the form of a whirlwind that periodically deals physical damage in an area of effect. They have the ability Far Shot, meaning that their skills do more damage at long range.

The Goddess of Purity is a unique Auric Colossus located in The Solaris Temple Level 2. She uses Ice Nova and summons Holy Water and Pure Water elementals to fight beside her. A version of The Goddess of Purity also appears in the Descent area Tomb of Statues.

is a hero that was created for the pitch meeting for Prometheus, which became Overwatch. His design is taken from unused Titan concept art. He had the following abilities: *Claws *Ice Storm *Freeze Snap

Karoo is Nefertari Vivi's pet super spot-billed duck. A fleet riding bird, one of the fastest modes of transportation available in the Arabasta Kingdom, he is captain of the Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops. Alongside Vivi, Karoo infiltrated the criminal syndicate Baroque Works, eventually uncovering Sir Crocodile's conspiracy against Arabsta. After their covers were blown, he joined his mistress as a traveling companion to the Straw Hat Pirates for most of the Arabasta Saga.
Iscat is a giant cat previously locked in the Land of Gods' diorama, where it ruled Bigstein Castle. It is the Sun God's pet.

The Gasha Gasha no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to telekinetically disassemble objects and reassemble them into whatever they please, making them an . It was eaten by Douglas Bullet.
Biblo is a very old, giant owl and the chief librarian of the Owl Library, overseeing everything inside and keeping its books giant-sized.

Mū creates several rocks and uses them to strike the opponent. Then, he forms a hand of the Stone Golem, which trips the opponent and forms into a full-body golem, punching the opponent and sending them flying.

Mū creates an array of stone pillars, striking the opponent. Then, he creates the upper part of a Stone Golem, punching the opponent and finishing them off by creating a full-body golem that slams its hand down, flattening the target to the ground.
Transformed as Son Gokū, Rōshi begins banging on his chest, stunning and damaging his opponent with the shockwaves created.

After slamming his hands on the ground, Iō sends a multitude of rocks from the ground to fly at the target. If need be, Iō can use this technique in conjunction with sealing tags to restrict an opponent's movements.

This technique is a variation of the Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm where either two Gentle Fist users, or a single person using both hands, sends a powerful wave of compressed chakra from either palm simultaneously and with great force towards an opponent. The chakra released from the user's palms targets their opponent's vitals while also knocking them off their feet with concussive force.
This technique allows Hiruko to control stones and rocks in the area to attack the enemy, forming several enormous jaws made out of the earth that will swallow and crush the enemy.

Temari uses her Giant Folding Fan to generate a gust of wind that layers the surrounding area in a blast of sand. Kinshiki manifests several different bladed weapons and hurls them at his opponent.

Orochimaru summons a coffin like the one used in the Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation technique. Ghostly hands come out of the coffin, extending through the body of the opponent, damaging them, until a larger hand grasps them, crushes them, and pulls them into the ethereal dark void within the coffin. The lid closes on the coffin and begins to sink into the darkness surrounding it. Orochimaru laughs sinisterly, watching as it vanishes.

Shisui uses the Body Flicker Technique, and moves around creating several afterimages. With his speed, he can move between his afterimages, and deliver attacks from each of them, each of them having mass behind them. If attacked, he moves out of the way, letting his opponent's attack go through one of his afterimages. He is able to move so fast between the afterimages that not only is each one indistinguishable via Sensor Types, but he can also attack opponents with several afterimages at once.
Hikari spews flames that split into three waves in three separate directions. pl:Uwolnienie Ognia: Technika Fali Płomieni
Fugaku spews flames that envelop the opponent in a fiery sphere, bursting with them within it.
Manipulating her dimension, Kaguya creates a twister of sand that sucks in the opponent.
Gari punches the ground, the explosion causing the earth to upturn, unbalancing his opponents.
Stretching both his arms, Mitsuki delivers a rapid fire barrage of punches to his opponent. pl:Takerikuchinawa
While in her lava dimension, Kaguya causes lava plumes to rise around her, either to attack nearby opponents or to block incoming attacks.
Madara swings his war fan and breathes fire into the swing, creating a wall of flaming whirlwinds.

Fire erupts around the user's body in a spiralling manner which is then launched with his hands towards the target. Once the technique hits the target, the opponent is sent into the air in a spiralling manner and their body burns into ashes.

Deidara releases a glob of explosive clay from both his hands that he forms into deformed human-like figures. Deidara then uses them to fight his opponent in close combat. Their body structure allows them to extend their body parts and not be sliced by normal means, however, a lightning-infused chop or sword will suffice. If a clay figure loses a body part, Deidara can simply attach a clay cord to it and form another clay figure. As the clay figures are made from explosive clay, Deidara can also detonate them at any moment while they are fighting the opponent.

A bat is a type of flying mammal, and a primary antagonist of the Minecraft: Woodsword Chronicles book
Mega-Mobbo, also known as Mobbozilla, is a ginormous golem made in the image of Mobbo, created by Jonathan Minecraft as part of his quest to bring about Mobbocraft.
Guardians are aquatic hostile mobs that spawn in ocean monuments. They attack with a slow-charging laser beam, and inflict retaliatory damage when damaged by a melee attack.

Elisa was a young girl who possessed powerful ESP and psychic abilities. Ursula was her alternate personality. The wildly different personalities made it fairly easy for the girl to pass herself off as a pair of twins. Each personality had different abilities and training.

Tigrex is a creature possessing a rock-solid body and razor-sharp fangs and was considered to be the "king of beasts." Tigrex is a "Pseudowyvern", differentiated from Flying Wyverns like Rathalos by the way its wings can be used as forelegs for quadrupedal movement on land. Tigrex has a tawny coloration with blue stripes, and a head shaped similarly to a Tyrannosaurus Rex.
Gold Phoenix was an Aerial Warrior Beast that fought along Vulcania and Great Mammoth in episode 55 of the Great Mazinger Anime.
Matriarch Benezia is a very powerful asari biotic and spiritual leader among her people, but Shepard finds her working alongside Saren Arterius, leading to a deadly confrontation on Noveria.
